searchText: Hi <@!436721623014572042> , great to hear that. Feel free to also join our discord if you want to discuss something specific regarding the Nim implementation: https://discord.gg/Na5Ah9JS If you have questions, feel free to ask early on. I'd also suggest to share a (draft) PR early on so we know the direction you are going. Aside from that, I'll create an issue in nim-eth Github with a description, so that could also be a place to follow up on the technicalities of the implementation. As Piper mentioned, it is actually about using uTP to stream data from "within" the discv5 protocol. One part here is, obviously, the implementation of the uTP protocol. This can be for the bigger part stand-alone from discv5 probably. Another part is how to properly integrate this with current discv5 packet and/or message types. There are some different approaches possible here, but I'm not sure if this is supposed to be part of your project? implementers call in 5 minutes (If anyone wants a standing invite to the call DM me the email address you'd like the invite sent to) https://us02web.zoom.us/j/82763999854?pwd=Uy9sR1ZxeUJhc0crckFKanV5VERCdz09 <@!425615769280315392> did you have any thoughts on https://github.com/carver/trin/pull/33 ? Looks good, merged Perfect, here's the new discv5: https://github.com/carver/trin/pull/34 Also merged! We're back to not allowing ENRs that don't match the actual public IP, btw Apparently if a node isn't certain of its public address, it shouldn't send one.
